# # Collateral Stuff
We take collateral for loans and trades. People should check the things and make sure they look good.
Sometimes we ask legal if it's okay. Most of the time it's fine.
We mostly do bonds and stocks but sometimes other things. If something is risky then maybe apply a discount. The desk decides what works. There is no need to write everything down because peopleknow what to do.
Exceptions happen but usually we just do it. Reporting is ad hoc and only done when someone asks.
There is no formal monitoring, and roles are not really defined.
This document does not follow any real structure.
